name: Aisle Survive
storyline:
Jade operates the last human-run store in Mech City. Her employees must work harder and faster than any robot in existence - or suffer the consequences.

Glen, however, has reached his limit. He's done with retail; he's ready to quit. But there's just one problem: If he doesn't work his notice, Jade will ruin him. He will never work again.

He has no choice. He must finish the week. That's all. One week.
summary:
Aisle Survive is a retail rogue-like, a deli-crawling dystopia and a supermarket survivor like no other. The customers will crush you. The banana skins are baying for your blood. Finish the job before the job finishes you.

Survive a week at the last human-run store in Mech City. Melee, multi-task and manage your stress to meet your boss' crushing standards - and stop the revolution.
